engine: PGlite embedded PostgreSQL; Supabase auth/storage schemas and default grants modeled locally

results.name: all migrations apply on clean PostgreSQL-compatible database
new accounts get one free game
starting a session charges once; resume does not charge again
another account cannot update or read the first session
ordinary player cannot directly change balance
finished sessions cannot be reopened by their owner
gift redemption is limited to once per user
gift codes accept lowercase input like their uppercase canonical form
delete floor blocks reduction from twenty to nineteen
moving a question respects the same twenty-question floor
ordinary users cannot call admin question functions
only super admins read contact messages
reporting only accepts questions actually shown in a completed session
bank mode cannot activate with an incomplete seed when expectation omitted
